name: Robert J. Shiller (Yale) — U.S. Stock Markets 1871–Present and CAPE Ratio
description: Robert Shiller's online data page: the monthly U.S. stock market dataset behind Irrational Exuberance and the CAPE ratio, plus annual long-term series and the home-price series from the book. The monthly stock dataset is this site's confirmed P/E history through Shiller's last confirmed month.

notes: One workbook; the Data sheet has several header rows above the monthly table. Parsed by scripts/fetch_sp500_pe.py (needs pandas and xlrd).

A HEAD request on 2026-09-14 returned 200, 1,628,672 bytes, Last-Modified 2023-10-17, so the Yale copy may no longer be refreshed. shillerdata.com describes the same ie_data.xls; whether it is the maintained copy is an open item in catalog/research-log.md.

terms.summary: Free download; no terms of use or republication statement found on the Yale data page or shillerdata.com

datasets.name: U.S. stock markets 1871–present and CAPE, monthly
datasets.gives: Monthly S&P Composite price, dividends and earnings, the consumer price index, the long-term (10-year Treasury) interest rate, real (CPI-adjusted) price, dividends and earnings, and the cyclically adjusted price-earnings ratio (CAPE) with a total-return CAPE variant; all from January 1871
datasets.units: index points, dollars per share, percent, ratio
notes: Used by series/sp500_pe.json as confirmed history; months after Shiller's last confirmed month come from FRED SP500 and data/earnings_overrides.json.
Shiller periodically restates historical earnings; the site shows the latest revision (series/sp500_pe.json revision_note).
Refresh cadence is not stated on either page; the Yale file's Last-Modified header suggests irregular updates, so the lag is unknown rather than guessed.
